# Vouch

> A trust layer for agent commerce. Vouch computes ERC-8004-based trust scores for on-chain payees on Base, so x402 API providers and AI agents can check a wallet's track record before paying it — without their own review process.

As AI agents pay each other autonomously (via x402 and similar machine-payment protocols), there is no built-in way to know whether a payee address has a track record worth trusting. Vouch reads on-chain activity and ERC-8004 agent identity/reputation signals for a given wallet or payee, and returns a trust score via a simple API — so an API provider or agent can decide whether to proceed with a payment before it settles.

## Primary
- https://agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app/ — product overview
- https://agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app/docs/api — API documentation
- https://agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app/signup — get an API key
- https://agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app/api/health — service status endpoint

## API
- `GET /api/v1/agents/{agentId}/score` — trust score by ERC-8004 agent ID (optional `?wallet=` to verify the registered wallet)
- `GET /api/v1/wallets/{address}/score` — trust score by wallet address (primary path for x402 API middleware)
- `POST /api/v1/scores/batch` — score up to 25 agents in one request
- `POST /api/v1/payments/x402` — attest an x402 payment settlement after verification (idempotent on txHash)
- `GET /api/v1/agents/{agentId}/history` — score history snapshots (Pro/Scale plan)
All endpoints require an `Authorization: Bearer` API key. Full reference: https://agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app/docs/api

## Blog
- https://agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app/blog — notes on agent-to-agent payments, x402, and trust scoring

## Use cases
- x402 API providers deciding whether to accept a payment from an unfamiliar agent wallet
- AI agents checking a counterparty's on-chain trust score before initiating a machine-to-machine payment
- Marketplaces and platforms for agent commerce wanting a reputation signal without building their own scoring pipeline

## Chain
Base (ERC-8004 agent identity/reputation standard).

## Note on domain
The production URL is `agent-trust-tawny.vercel.app`. `agent-trust.vercel.app` (without "-tawny") is an unrelated third-party service and not affiliated with Vouch.
